class CsvError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, line: int, col: int):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.line = line

def parse(text: str, dialect: dict) -> list:
    if text.startswith("\ufeff"):
        text = text[1:]
    d = dialect or {}
    p = _Parser(text, d)
    records = p.parse_records()
    if not records:
        return []
    if d.get("header", False):
        header_fields = records[0]
        names = _header_names(header_fields)
        fill = d.get("fill")
        if fill is None:
            # default None, but if fill key absent None. If fill explicitly None, same.
            pass
        out = []
        for rec in records[1:]:
            fields = [_convert(raw, quoted, d) for raw, quoted in rec]
            row = {}
            if len(fields) < len(names):
                for name, value in zip(names, fields):
                    row[name] = value
                for name in names[len(fields):]:
                    row[name] = fill
            else:
                for name, value in zip(names, fields):
                    row[name] = value
                if len(fields) > len(names):
                    row["_extra"] = fields[len(names):]
            out.append(row)
        return out
    return [[_convert(raw, quoted, d) for raw, quoted in rec] for rec in records]

    return True
